description: Agent2Agent protocol: an open standard for delegating work to independently deployed, opaque agents through tasks, messages and artifacts. `emerging`.
A JSON document (usually at `/.well-known/agent-card.json`) declaring an agent's interfaces, capabilities, skills and security schemes; it can be signed.
A2A's stateful unit of work, with states submitted, working, input-required, auth-required, and the terminal completed, failed, canceled and rejected.
Groups related tasks and messages into one conversation; follow-ups to a finished task are new tasks in the same context.
A webhook the client registers so the remote agent can report task updates for work that outlives any connection.
MCP connects an agent to its tools and data (vertical); A2A connects agents to peer agents across deployments and organizations (horizontal).
